blocks.text: "My change isn't running" has four causes: no rebuild, no recreate, a reattached anonymous volume, or a populated named volume hiding new image content.

rows: Named volume over image-owned path only filled when empty
Don't mount over image assets, or remove the volume

blocks.code:
services:
  web:
    volumes:
      - .:/app
      - /app/.venv      # anonymous volume: keeps the OLD venv after rebuilds

blocks.text: Adding a dependency and rebuilding still fails with ModuleNotFoundError: the old anonymous volume hides the new image's venv.

$ docker compose images                       # image each container runs
$ docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' rag-api-1
$ docker compose exec api cat /app/app/version.py

Q: "You rebuilt after adding a package but get ModuleNotFoundError. What happened?" A: "The service mounts an anonymous volume over the venv path. Compose reattached the old volume on recreate, hiding the new venv. Recreate with -V (--renew-anon-volumes), or stop mounting over dependency directories."

items: Confirm the running image and files first.
